review.thanks: Thank you. The translation team will see your answer.
review.privacyNote: Your name, answer and voice clips go to the translation team that sent this link.
review.checkConnection: Check your connection and reload this page.
review.askForNew: Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
review.linkClosed: This review link has closed. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
review.audioFailed: The audio did not load. Reload the page to try again.
review.tooManyClips: That is as many clips as one answer takes. Remove one to add another.
review.micBlocked: The microphone was not allowed. You can still write a comment.
review.clipNotKept: That clip could not be kept. Try again, or write a comment.
review.chooseFirst: Choose Good or Needs changes first.
review.nameFirst: Type your name first. Any name will do.
review.clipDidNotSend: A voice clip did not send.
review.stillHere: {{reason}} Your answer is still here; tap Send again.

connect.title: Connect an app
connect.intro: Give a listening app, a website or an AI agent access to your organization's translations. It can do only what you choose here, and never more than you can do yourself.
connect.signInSub: With the account you use in the LangQuest app.
connect.requestTitle: An app is asking for access
connect.makeSub: For an app or agent you set up yourself. You see the token once, so copy it somewhere safe.
connect.wrongPassword: That email and password did not match.
connect.cannotReview: (you cannot review or translate here, so it cannot record reviews)
connect.mcp: Or add LangQuest to an AI agent as an MCP server:
connect.name: Name
connect.revokeConfirm: Revoke this token? Anything using it stops working at once.
connect.stateApproved: This request is approved. The app can carry on.
connect.checkCode: Check this matches the code the app shows.
connect.approveOnly: Approve only if you started this yourself, in an app or agent in front of you. If someone sent you this link, deny it.
connect.selfNamed: That is what the app calls itself. LangQuest cannot check it, so approve only an app you just asked to connect.
connect.writesUnticked: Anything that writes as you (reviews, releases, external values) starts unticked: tick it only if the app needs it.
connect.approved: Approved. {{app}} is connected; you can close this page. Revoke it below at any time.
connect.noOrganization: You are not in an organization with languages yet, so there is nothing to connect.
connect.notConfigured: This server has no sign-in configuration (SUPABASE_ANON_KEY).

scopes.readPublished: Read the approved version of each passage and play its audio
scopes.read: Read every passage shared for review, with its versions and reviews
scopes.review: Record reviews as you: listener feedback, or a review step in the flow, with a comment or a voice note
scopes.release: Say where a version is published (live in an app or on a site), or taken down
scopes.externalValues: Store the app's own values with your languages, as you. LangQuest keeps them and never acts on them
